name: Surat Thani Airport to Koh Lanta

seo.title: Surat Thani to Koh Lanta Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Surat Thani (airport, bus terminal or Donsak Pier) and Koh Lanta, both directions. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

h1: Surat Thani Airport to Koh Lanta by private minivan
lead: From Surat Thani Airport (URT), the bus terminal or Donsak Pier to your hotel on Koh Lanta, and back. Private vehicle, your group only.

facts.label: Drive time
facts.value: About 4 to 5 hours, depending on traffic

facts.label: Pickup and drop-off
facts.value: Surat Thani Airport (URT), Surat Thani bus terminal, Donsak Pier, Your hotel on Koh Lanta

faq.q: Do you pick up at Donsak Pier?
faq.a: Yes. Donsak Pier is one of the places we drive to and from. Enter it as the pickup or the destination.

faq.q: Can you pick up at Surat Thani bus terminal?
faq.a: Yes. Give us the arrival time of your bus.

legacyText.title: Surat Thani to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
body: We pick you up at Surat Thani Airport, at the bus terminal or at Donsak Pier, and drive you to your hotel on Koh Lanta. Tell us which one and at what time.
